hero.titleA: The local control room for your
hero.sub: Nakiros manages, normalizes, audits and fixes every skill, agent, rule, hook and setting Claude Code writes to your machine — to spec.
hero.description: Many skills add nothing. Some even make Claude worse. Nakiros audits them, runs evals with and without, and tells you which ones to keep, improve, or drop.
hero.installHint: Then type `nakiros` — your browser opens on localhost.

etymology.title: Two words, one purpose.

nakama.meaning: The companion, the teammate, the one who has your back.

kairos.meaning: The Greek god of the right moment. The one who knows when to step in.

etymology.synthesis: Nakiros — the companion that shows up at the right moment. Inside the tool you already use every day, Claude Code.

problem.label: 01 — UNMANAGED
problem.title: Your .claude folder grew without you noticing.
problem.sub: Skills accumulate. Hooks contradict. Agents drift from spec. Settings disagree across projects. Nothing checks any of it.

pillars.label: skills, no eval
pillars.desc: Drafted, copy-pasted, never tested against your real history.

pillars.label: hooks running blind
pillars.desc: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SessionStart — no log, no audit, no idea if they fire.

pillars.label: agents off-spec
pillars.desc: Frontmatter missing required fields. Some have no description. One has no model pinned.

pillars.label: settings drift
pillars.desc: project / user / managed — different permissions, no source of truth.

room.label: 02 — THE CONTROL ROOM
room.title: Every artifact in .claude, in one place.
room.sub: Nakiros indexes ~/.claude and every project-local .claude/. Files, frontmatter, dependencies, run history — one read-only canonical view.

tree.coverageHint: of all .claude artifacts pass the official spec

Last-used timestamp from your real conversation history

audit.headline: 11/14 checks passed
audit.subline: 3 findings — 1 critical, 2 warnings. The skill drifts from the official Claude Code spec on frontmatter and retry policy.

findings.text: SKILL.md frontmatter missing 'model' field — required by the official spec.
No retry budget in the tool-error path — agent loops indefinitely on permission_denied.
References point to a non-existent path: docs/auth-flow.md.

eval.headline: 9/9 sessions beat baseline on iter 5
eval.subline: Each cell is pass / total on real conversation fixtures. Green ≥ 85%, amber 50–85%, red < 50%.

standard.label: 03 — STANDARDIZED
standard.title: Held to the official Claude Code spec — not vibes.
standard.sub: Nakiros ships with the canonical schema for every .claude artifact. Frontmatter, file layout, naming, sub-skill resources — checked on every scan.

checks.name: SKILL.md frontmatter
checks.info: name · description · model — required keys, length limits, allowed values.

checks.name: Agent file shape
checks.info: Top-level frontmatter, system prompt body, allowed-tools array shape.

checks.name: Hook event keys
checks.info: Each entry in settings.json must be a valid event: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, SessionStart…

checks.name: Settings precedence
checks.info: managed > project > user — no contradictory permissions across layers.

checks.name: Rules + output-styles
checks.info: Rules frontmatter (`paths` glob), output-style required fields (`name`, `description`).

audit.label: 04 — AUDIT
audit.title: A worker re-reads what your agent actually did.
audit.sub: For every artifact, Nakiros runs a forensic audit through your local Claude CLI. It reads the conversations that touched the skill, the diffs it produced, the tool errors it caused — and writes a report.

bullets.v: Failed to short-circuit on Bash permission errors in 5 / 9 sampled sessions.
Retries the same tool call within 3 messages — no exponential backoff written.
~146k cache rewrite tokens wasted on retries (last 7 days).
Add a guard clause + retry budget to SKILL.md. See proposal v2.

fix.label: 05 — FIX
fix.title: Every audit ends with a proposal. You decide.
fix.sub: Nakiros doesn't edit your .claude on its own. It drafts a versioned proposal, runs evals against your real conversation history, and shows you the delta. One click to accept.
fix.detail: proposal-engine v2 — adds a retry budget and short-circuits on `permission denied`. Outperforms v1 on 9/9 sampled sessions.

factory.title: Skills carry their own evals. Or they don't exist.
factory.sub: Every skill in your .claude gets a lifecycle: draft → eval → ship. With trends, iteration logs, and a pass-rate per project.

local.label: 07 — LOCAL-FIRST
local.title: Your .claude never leaves your machine.
points: Storage: plain JSON + JSONL files under ~/.nakiros. Open them with any editor.
Audits run through your local Claude CLI — no API key, no extra cost, your existing plan.
Open source, MIT. Read the daemon, the UI, the prompts.

install.label: 08 — INSTALL
install.title: Install in three commands.
install.sub: Requires Node 20+. Install the CLI, register the background service (so the daemon survives reboots and powers real-time features like drift detection), then open the UI.

lines.c: registered launchd unit · daemon running on 127.0.0.1:4242
indexed 4 skills · 3 agents · 2 rules · 1 output-style in 1.4s
checking against the official Claude Code spec ...

install.tip: `nakiros service install` registers a launchd / systemd unit so the daemon auto-starts at login. Real-time features (drift detection, conversation ingestion) need the daemon up — without it, the hooks fail silent.

items.a: Not without your hand. The daemon is read-only by default. Every fix is a proposal — you accept it and Nakiros writes a versioned commit. You can revert any change.
The official Claude Code documentation. Skills, sub-agents, hooks, settings, rules, output-styles — same shape, same validation. We track the docs as upstream.

items.q: Does it send my conversations anywhere?
items.a: No. Indexing and scoring are local. Audits go through your local Claude CLI — no API key, no extra billing, just your existing Claude plan.

items.q: Will it slow down my machine?
items.a: The scanner runs once at start and watches for new files. Idle CPU is ~0%. An audit run uses one CLI call per session it analyzes.

items.q: What if I have no .claude yet?
items.a: Nakiros bootstraps a clean one for you, with three example skills wired to evals — so you can see the loop work before you commit anything real.

items.q: Does it work without Claude Code?
items.a: No. Nakiros is built on top of the file format Claude Code writes. We may support other agent runtimes later, if their on-disk shape is open.
